description: This file contains functions for serializing and deserializing TorchScript modules, including saving, loading, and handling flatbuffer formats, with internal utility functions and external library references.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes a ScriptModule to a file or buffer, with optional extra files.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a ScriptModule or ScriptFunction from a file or buffer, with device remapping options.

methods.name: validate_map_location
methods.description: Validates and converts the map_location parameter for device remapping.

methods.name: jit_module_from_flatbuffer
methods.description: Loads a JIT module from a flatbuffer file or bytes.

methods.name: save_jit_module_to_flatbuffer
methods.description: Saves a ScriptModule into a flatbuffer format for inter-process use.

methods.name: get_flatbuffer_module_info
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information from a flatbuffer model file.
